privacy.heading: Privacy notice
privacy.intro: World Cup Madness is an internal Nortal prediction pool. Here is what we collect, why, and who can see it.
privacy.dataCollectedBody: Your corporate email address and your Microsoft display name. We receive both from your Microsoft work account when you sign in. We do not collect anything else from your Microsoft profile.
privacy.purposeBody: Email is used to verify that you are an eligible Nortal collaborator. Display name is shown on the leaderboard so colleagues can recognize you. Both, along with sign-in and prediction edit events, are recorded in an audit log so the tournament outcome can be reviewed.
privacy.audienceBody: Other participants see your display name and your points on the leaderboard. Tournament administrators can see your email address for support and eligibility purposes. No external service receives your data.
privacy.legalBasisBody: We process this data under legitimate interest in the context of your Nortal employment. Participation in the pool is voluntary; there is no separate consent step for MVP.
privacy.retentionHeading: How long we keep your data
privacy.retentionBody: Retention period for predictions, scores, and audit data after the tournament concludes will be set by Nortal Privacy and Legal before launch and added here.
privacy.welcomeSummary: We collect your corporate email and display name to verify eligibility and show your name on the leaderboard.
